name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Phone Dust Plug
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic and a transparent plug cover, offering a lightweight, durable, and stylish accessory finish.
    - Features a 1-layer acrylic charm with 3mm thickness, creating a cute and personalized decorative touch.
    - The acrylic charm is paired with a transparent dust plug for a clean and practical design.
    - Includes a metal circular ring to connect the charm to the dust plug attachment securely.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Acrylic charm size: 1.5 x 1.5 in ~ 3.8 x 3.8 cm
    - Transparent dust plug sizes:
            +) For Type-C: 0.9 x 1.1 cm ~ 0.35 x 0.43 in
            +) For Android: 0.9 x 1 cm ~ 0.35 x 0.39 in
            +) For Apple Lightning: 0.8 x 1.2 cm ~ 0.31 x 0.47 in
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the acrylic charm may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Supports 2-sided printing on the acrylic charm.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a decorative charm and a protective phone dust plug.
    - Designed to help cover the phone charging port while adding a fun personalized accent.
    - Suitable for Type-C, Android, or Apple Lightning devices, depending on the selected option.
    - Lightweight and easy to attach, making it convenient for everyday use.
    - Perfect for decorating phones, gifting as a small keepsake, or adding personality to daily tech accessories.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for teachers, students, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, teacher appreciation, back-to-school gifts, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves cute accessories, personalized items, and small thoughtful keepsakes.
    - A thoughtful gift for daily use that combines decoration and practicality.
    - Great for stocking stuffers, appreciation gifts, party favors, and custom surprises.
    - Adds a cute, fun, and personal touch to everyday devices🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Phone Dust Plug

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
